items.title: Meta’s Muse just changed the AI game
items.summary: Is Meta finally catching up to OpenAI and Anthropic? In The Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen heads to Qualcomm's Snapdragon Summit in Maui to break down Meta's Muse: the AI model suddenly turning heads across the industry as a serious contender in the AI race. Then, Ejaaz sits down with Qualcomm CFO & COO Akash Palkhiwala for an inside look at how the chip giant is betting big on agentic AI, straight from one of tech's biggest stages.

items.title: Qualcomm CFO on agentic AI and the race to the edge
items.summary: In the Loop Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen welcomes Qualcomm (QCOM) CFO and COO Akash Palkhiwala from the company's annual Snapdragon Summit in Maui, Hawaii, to discuss the rise of agentic AI and explain the key differences between cloud and edge computing.

items.title: Apple’s New CEO Is Already Being Pressured to Drop the Chinese Chip Deal Tim Cook Fought to Keep
items.summary: John Ternus has barely settled into the CEO chair when Washington starts pressuring him to abandon the memory chip deal Tim Cook spent a year fighting to protect, and the pressure is arriving at the worst possible moment for iPhone pricing.
